title: Separuh Masa Neraka
notes: Source of truth for Episode 11 — Finale Part 1. Besi Waja lead 0-2 at halftime; a tactical foul adds a RM5,000 league fine and bank late fee (RM300,000 -> RM305,000). Bos hands the vacant captain armband to Azam. Ends with the standard 72-frame Buluh FC / EPISOD 11 card. No CTAs.

scenes.name: Act 1 — Silenced by Besi Waja
scenes.visual: Frame 0: PENGADIL flashes a yellow card straight into the camera. Silent, disciplined Besi Waja shut Buluh FC down; Malik is an immovable wall. MatchHUD 0-2 at halftime and the debt ticks RED to RM305,000 as the lawyer watches from the sideline.
scenes.sfx: sharp whistle at frame 0; card flick; heavy tackle thud; cold bank tick.
scenes.bgm: Oppressive low match bed, ducked under dialogue.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Besi Waja. Tak kalah. Senyap. Dan mereka datang nak tanam kita.
lines.translation: Besi Waja. Undefeated. Silent. And they're here to bury us.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Nol dua di separuh masa. Denda kad dan caj bank: lima ribu. Hutang naik.
lines.translation: Nil-two at halftime. Card fine and bank late fee: five grand. The debt climbs.

scenes.name: Act 2 — Halftime Despair
scenes.visual: Halftime. Heads down in the locker room; the tactical whiteboard shows 5-3-2 magnets and a red HUTANG sticky note. Farid says they can't beat Besi Waja without Karim.
scenes.sfx: door click; low room tone; board magnet tap; heavy sigh.
scenes.bgm: Sparse, unhappy locker-room bed, ducked under dialogue.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Bilik ganti sunyi. Semua kepala down. Baju basah, lampu berkelip.
lines.translation: The locker room is silent. Every head down. Wet kits, flickering lights.

lines.speaker: FARID
lines.text: Kita tak boleh lawan diorang tanpa Karim. Serius.
lines.translation: We can't beat them without Karim. Seriously.

lines.speaker: AZAM
lines.text: Dia dah pergi. Kita masih kena berdiri.
lines.translation: He's gone. We still have to stand.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Pintu terbuka. Bos masuk, tak cakap apa-apa lagi.
lines.translation: The door opens. Boss walks in and says nothing.

scenes.name: Act 3 — The Armband
scenes.visual: Bos pulls Karim's gold captain armband from his pocket and holds it out to Azam: "Karim dah pergi. Hari ni, kau kapten Buluh FC." Hard cut on the cliffhanger.
scenes.sfx: soft cloth/gold scuff; bass swell; hard-cut impact.
scenes.bgm: Rising emotional bed, silent after the hard cut.

events.note: Gold armband held out to Azam.

lines.speaker: BOS
lines.text: Karim dah pergi. Hari ni, kau kapten Buluh FC.
lines.translation: Karim is gone. Today, you're the captain of Buluh FC.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Armband emas itu keluar dari poket. Azam tak tunduk.
lines.translation: The gold armband comes out of the pocket. Azam doesn't look away.

scenes.name: Buluh FC Series Outro
scenes.visual: Standard black Buluh FC / EPISOD 11 card. No CTA.
